decision: Retain existing computed grid alternatives at the original cut counts only after ordinary feature seeds and their near-miss retry fail. Do not change the production paper-resolution policy.

rejectedFirstProposal.cause: An unequal-count alternative displaced the half-resolution puppy’s finer-spline route and then lost its opening. The final implementation only retries the base count pair. The unchanged feature-shape/export regression passes with that guard.

audit.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

cropTransfer.method: 160-step independent continuations against the identical unresolved vertical crop. Different saved image-derived shapes, routing and segment counts can all affect the result. This demonstrates existence only, not fresh-solve speed or a production warm start.

qualifications: Scores compare with classified photographic masks, not ground-truth cutting paths. No physical assembly testing.
The original real-photo corpus remains 24/31; the newly passing crop perturbation is a separate regression.
The vertical translation remains rejected; rounded rays and border deviations remain visible.
Time-bounded fits vary on unchanged paths; individual before/after scores are retained.
The browser uses the UI 180-second allowance. Click-to-ready timings are separate from the native ten-second regression and Hunodan checks.
Continuation experiments start from saved image-derived fits and do not establish fresh end-to-end speed. Changing the material lattice also changes the fitting margin.
